editorial:
Imagine being so picky about dating that you basically give up on real men. That is where you find Sarah, a woman who spends her winters building the most detailed snowmen with her best friend, Nick. It is a cozy, wintery setup that feels like a warm blanket on a cold night. Everything changes when one of her sculptures vanishes, and a handsome stranger named Cole appears in its place. He is everything Sarah ever wanted in a partner, making the whole vibe feel like a magical fairy tale come to life.

You will love how the chemistry between the leads keeps the story moving, even if some of the plot feels a bit predictable. The pacing is steady, though it leans heavily into the sweetness of the romance. If you want a low-stress movie to relax with, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but you could also rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this holiday magic forever.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that Cole is actually the snowman brought to life by magic. As the weather warms up, he starts to fade away. However, the real magic happens when Sarah realizes that her childhood friend Nick was the perfect man all along. Cole disappears back into the winter air, but he leaves Sarah with the confidence to stop being so picky and finally start a real relationship with Nick.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy holiday romances and magic
